function.name: register_decoders
function.description: This function registers decoders by creating and setting values in the Windows registry. It iterates through a list of decoders, creating keys and setting values for each one. If any operation fails, it cleans up by closing any open keys and returns an error.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a constant list of decoders to be registered. Each decoder in the list has several properties, including clsid, author, friendlyname, vendor, container_format, version, mimetypes, extensions, formats, and patterns.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows programming to represent error conditions, and status codes. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code obtained from the HRESULT_FROM_WIN32 macro with the value of 'res'.

function.name: unregister_decoders
function.description: This function unregisters decoders by manipulating the Windows registry. It opens the registry key for the decoder, checks for errors, and if successful, it iterates through the list of decoders, deleting each one from the registry. If any errors occur during this process, it closes the registry keys and returns an error code.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a list of decoders that are to be unregistered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns S_OK if the function successfully unregisters the decoders, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: register_encoders
function.description: This function registers encoders by creating and setting values in the Windows Registry. It iterates over a list of encoders, creating keys and setting values for each encoder's properties such as author, friendly name, vendor, container format, version, mime types, extensions and formats.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of encoders to be registered

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code obtained from the Win32 error code.

function.name: unregister_encoders
function.description: This function unregisters encoders by deleting the corresponding registry keys. It opens the registry key for the class identifier (CLSID), creates keys for the bitmap encoders and the instance, and then iterates through the list of encoders, deleting each one from the registry.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of encoders to be unregistered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: register_converters
function.description: This function registers a list of converters in the Windows registry. It creates registry keys for each converter and sets values for the converter's CLSID, author, friendly name, vendor, version, and supported pixel formats.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of converters to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns an error code.

function.name: unregister_converters
function.description: This function unregisters converters by deleting the relevant keys from the Windows registry. It iterates over a list of converters, deleting each one from the registry. If a converter is not found, it is considered a success. Any other error will stop the process and the function will return an error code.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of converters to be unregistered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: register_metadatareaders
function.description: This function registers metadata readers in the system registry. It creates registry keys and sets values for various properties of the metadata reader such as author, friendly name, vendor, metadata format, version, spec version, requires full stream, supports padding, requires fixed size, and containers. It handles errors by closing the relevant keys and returning an HRESULT indicating the status of the operation.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a list of metadata readers to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code obtained from the Win32 function HRESULT_FROM_WIN32.

function.name: unregister_metadatareaders
function.description: This function unregisters metadata readers by manipulating the Windows registry. It opens the registry key for the class, creates keys for the metadata reader and its instance, and then iterates over a list of metadata readers, deleting each from the registry.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of metadata readers to be unregistered

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code obtained from the HRESULT_FROM_WIN32 macro.

function.name: register_metadatawriters
function.description: This function registers metadata writers in the system registry.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of metadata writers to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns an error code.

function.name: unregister_metadatawriters
function.description: This function unregisters metadata writers by deleting the corresponding registry keys.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of metadata writers to be unregistered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: register_pixelformats
function.description: This function registers pixel formats by creating and setting values in the Windows registry. It iterates over a list of pixel formats, creating keys for each one and setting values for various properties such as author, friendly name, vendor, version, bits per pixel, channel count, numeric representation, supports alpha, and channel masks.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to a list of pixel formats to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code obtained from the HRESULT_FROM_WIN32 macro.

function.name: unregister_pixelformats
function.description: This function unregisters pixel formats by deleting the corresponding keys from the registry. It handles errors and returns appropriate status codes.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a list of pixel formats to be unregistered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status code of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: register_categories
function.description: This function registers categories in the Windows registry. It creates keys for the class, categories, and instances. If any key creation fails, it closes all open keys and returns an error. If all keys are successfully created, it sets the value for the instance class ID key and closes all keys. The function returns a success status if all operations are successful.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a list of categories to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operations. It returns S_OK for success, or an error code for failure.

function.name: unregister_categories
function.description: This function unregisters categories from the registry. It opens the registry keys, checks for errors, and if no errors are found, it deletes the registry tree for each category in the list.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a list of categories to be unregistered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: DllRegisterServer
function.description: This function registers various components such as categories, decoders, encoders, converters, metadata readers, metadata writers, and pixel formats. It uses the Windows Imaging Component (WIC) to register the server.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function execution. It returns S_OK if all components are registered successfully, otherwise it returns a failure code.

function.name: DllUnregisterServer
function.description: This function unregisters various components such as categories, decoders, encoders, converters, metadata readers, metadata writers, and pixel formats. It uses the SUCCEEDED macro to check the success of each unregister operation.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operations. If all operations are successful, it returns the result of the last operation.
